products.title: Beauty and the Base Smoothing Base Coat
products.body_html: The milky base coat of your dreams has arrived! This super sheer petal pink base coat smooths and nourishes to create the perfect start to your manicure. AHAs and hibiscus flower extract nourish and moisturize the nail plate while the subtle ridge filling smooths out any imperfections! Ingredients: Butyl Acetate, Ethyl Acetate, Nitrocellulose, Adipic Acid/Neopentyl Glycol/Trimellitic Anhydride Copolymer, Acetyl Tributyl Citrate, Isopropyl Alcohol, Silica, Acrylates Copolymer, Oryza Sativa Starch, Glycolic Acid, Water, N-Butyl Alcohol, Etocrylene, Olive Oil Decyl Esters, Hibiscus Sabdariffa Flower Extract, Titanium Dioxide, Hexanal, Squalene, Lithothamnion Calcareum Extract, Mannitol, Iron Oxides, Aluminum Hydroxide, Triethoxycaprylysilane, Diatomaceous Earth, Zinc Sulfate, Tocopherol 15 mL / .5 fl oz.
